en.headline: Hong Kong’s first chief executive Tung Chee-hwa dies aged 89
en.dek: The former shipping tycoon and CPPCC vice-chairman passed away peacefully on Tuesday evening surrounded by family, his office said in a statement issued early Wednesday.
body: Hong Kong’s first chief executive, Tung Chee-hwa, has died at the age of 89, his office announced in the early hours of Wednesday.

Tung passed away peacefully on Tuesday evening, 8 September, surrounded by his loved ones, according to the statement. The office described him as a man of unwavering integrity who devoted himself wholeheartedly to the nation, adding that his noble character and spirit would stay forever in people’s hearts.

Tung served as the city’s first leader after the 1997 handover from Britain to China, holding office until March 2005 when he resigned citing health reasons. He later served as a vice-chairman of the Chinese People’s Political Consultative Conference until 2023. He had largely withdrawn from public life after July 2021.

Former chief executive Leung Chun-ying expressed deep sorrow, saying Tung had led the establishment of the Hong Kong Special Administrative Region with the nation’s high trust, implemented “one country, two systems”, and planned the city’s long-term development while addressing deep-seated livelihood issues.

zh.headline: 香港首任行政長官董建華離世 享年89歲
zh.dek: 董建華辦公室凌晨發聲明，指前全國政協副主席、首任行政長官於周二晚安詳辭世，摯親隨侍。
body: 香港特別行政區首任行政長官董建華離世，享年89歲。董建華辦公室於周三凌晨發表聲明，公布這位前全國政協副主席於2026年9月8日安詳辭世，摯親隨侍在側。
聲明形容董建華為人剛正不阿，胸懷家國，鞠躬盡瘁，其高風亮節的精神將永垂不朽，長存心中。
董建華在1997年香港回歸後出任首任行政長官，至2005年3月以健康理由辭職。其後出任全國政協副主席至2023年。他自2021年7月起甚少公開露面。
前行政長官梁振英表示沉痛哀悼，指董建華領導香港成立特別行政區及政府，獲得國家高度信任，落實「一國兩制」、「港人治港」、高度自治，高瞻遠矚謀劃香港長遠發展及解決深層次民生問題，宅心仁厚、以理服人，是後輩典範。
